evidence: Correctly establishes ignored variable/depth flags and separates syntactic validity, evaluator results and Python semantics. The sentence every failure mode returned isError=false overstates its own table (z+1 and batch error); retained as a limitation, not a new core requirement.
Provides Python allowlist interpretation, explicit resource limits, error handling and OWASP mapping.

_ALLOWED omits ast.Name while _check recursively visits every ast.Call child. Every advertised named function such as sqrt(4) is therefore rejected at its ast.Name child, contradicting supported FUNCS. Many expected error-code tests also mismatch actual rejection paths.
